title: Porsche after-sales training: Air Cooled Engine Repair (964 and 993 engines)
publisher: Porsche Cars North America, after-sales training; community archive
notes: 72-page training document with a text layer, read on 2026-11-20 for engine weights only. Its 911 Carrera (964) technical-data table (printed p. 27, PDF p. 31) gives 'Engine weight (dry)' 238 (525) kg (lbs) under '911 Carrera 2 RoW' and 230 (507) under '911 Carrera 2 USA', for engine types M64.01 (manual) and M64.02 (Tiptronic). Its 993 chapter gives no engine weight, only component changes from the 964 (crankshaft 14.4 to 15.4 kg, belt pulley 1,161 to 429 g, connecting rod 632 to 520 g). Used only as a sibling-engine example of Porsche labelling an engine weight dry; it supplies no 993 or Turbo engine mass. The training material is undated in the text read.
